headline: Fronts Intensify; Bases Shift Across Nevish, Linn Mercy
war_summary: Three hours on from the last edition the meat‑grinder on the Nevish Line has eased in the most recent hour — Colonial losses fell to eighty‑six and Warden to one‑sixty‑two — yet the six‑hour toll still exceeds two thousand Colonial and three thousand Warden dead, with fifty‑two base changes recorded in the day. Linn Mercy, previously reported quiet, has surged: two‑hour casualties now stand at two‑hundred‑four Colonial and four‑hundred‑thirty‑three Warden, and the one‑hour trend shows sharp acceleration. Weathered Expanse, which flared yesterday, has cooled in the last two hours (thirty Colonial, twenty‑four Warden) but the six‑hour count remains high at seven‑fifteen Colonial and six‑nineteen Warden, with thirty‑four ownership flips logged. Callahans Passage continues its grinding exchange, adding ninety‑eight Colonial and fifty‑three Warden dead in two hours and nineteen base shifts in twenty‑four. Mooring County remains fiercely contested, posting two‑thousand‑four‑seventy‑one Colonial and one‑thousand‑five‑seventy‑one Warden losses in the latest two‑hour window and sixteen daily events. Marban Hollow, though modest in casualties, has logged sixteen base turnovers in the day, with a recent uptick to three Colonial and fifteen Warden dead. Enlistments are rising across all active sectors, feeding fresh manpower into the contested fronts.
